The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] owned a '''starship''' that he used in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Slaver's Redemption" /> An [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] named [[T7-O1]] served as the ship's navigator but, because he never entered the cargo hold where Shafu's "goods" were kept, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was unaware that Shafu was a slaver.<ref name="The Confession">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|The Confession}}</ref> Sometime before [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' confirms that T7-O1 was working for Zallow in [[3681 BBY]] when he was serving on [[Nico Okarr]]'s ship.</ref> the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]] tracked down Shafu; however, instead of [[Death/Legends|killing]] or arresting him, Zallow convinced Shafu to reform, and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] became an undercover agent for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Shafu used his ship in that capacity for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]<ref name="Slaver's Redemption">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Slaver's Redemption}}</ref> until [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> when Shafu's investigations into an Imperial spy network led the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Terrin Sandafar]] to kill the Rodian. Sandafar sabotaged Shafu's ship<ref name="Terrin Sandafar">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Terrin Sandafar}}</ref> over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], causing it to explode and kill Shafu. Though his death was ruled accidental, years later, T7-O1 learned of Shafu's death and resumed his friend's investigation.<ref name="Shafu's Report" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shafu's ship was first mentioned in a number of conversations with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class companion T7-O1 in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].
